full_prompt_en: A square expressive mixed-media portrait shows an older man in left-facing profile, wearing a dark wide-brimmed hat and coat against a pale warm paper ground. His head occupies the upper left and center, with the long brim slanting over a deeply lined forehead and shadowing the eye. A prominent nose, thin closed mouth, rough cheek, and visible ear are drawn with dark brown and charcoal strokes. White hair or pale sideburns appear around the ear. The collar and shoulder begin as dark clothing at the lower center, then break apart into smoky blue-gray clouds and thin vertical drips toward the right and bottom. The hat also frays into a dark blue plume across the upper center, so the figure seems to disperse into weather or smoke. A large cream area remains open at the far left; near the lower left, a tiny distant mark suggests a solitary small figure on an almost blank ground. The portrait blends precise facial planes with watery stains, scraping, dry brush, and irregular splatter. Blue-black, slate, warm umber, and ivory make a narrow, moody palette. Light arrives softly from the left, catching the nose ridge and cheek while the eye socket and under-brim fall into deep shade. There is no readable text or definite interior setting. The face remains structurally clear amid the disintegrating paint edges. The overall composition sets a solid human profile against an expanding cloud of loose pigment, balancing quiet introspection with the turbulence of the mark-making.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性混合媒介肖像描绘一名年长男子朝左侧身，戴深色宽檐帽、穿深色外套，背后是浅暖纸面。头部占据左上与中央，长帽檐斜过多皱额头，遮暗眼睛。突出的鼻子、薄而闭合的嘴、粗糙面颊和可见耳朵由深棕与炭色笔触绘出。耳旁有白发或浅色鬓发。领口与肩膀在下方中央仍是深色衣物，随后向右和向下裂散为蓝灰烟云与细竖向流痕。帽子也在上方中央散成深蓝羽状烟团，使人物仿佛消融于天气或烟雾中。最左侧保留大片奶油色空间；左下附近一个极小的远处痕迹似乎暗示空旷地面上的独行小人。肖像把准确面部切面与水痕、刮擦、干刷和不规则泼点结合。蓝黑、石板灰、暖赭褐与象牙白组成狭窄阴郁色域。柔光从左侧进入，挑亮鼻梁与面颊，眼窝和帽檐下则沉入深影。没有可读文字或明确室内环境。尽管颜料边缘解体，面部结构仍然清晰。整体构图以坚实人物侧面面对扩张的松散色云，在安静内省和笔痕的躁动之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: An expressive mixed-media painted surface joins precise dark tonal planes to watery stains, dry-brush abrasion, scattered splashes, and descending drips. Slate blue, blue-black, warm umber, charcoal, and paper ivory create a narrow moody range. A concentrated solid area gradually fragments into translucent cloudlike pigment, giving the composition a strong directional expansion. Hard contours remain around the focal structure, while outer edges evaporate into the pale ground. Soft lateral light picks out selected ridges and leaves deep pockets beneath broad shadow masses. Large negative space offsets the textured plume and fine vertical traces. The finish is atmospheric, tactile, and quietly turbulent.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性混合媒介绘画表面将准确的深色明暗平面与水渍、干刷磨擦、散落泼点和下垂流痕接合。石板蓝、蓝黑、暖赭褐、炭色与纸白构成狭窄阴郁色域。集中的坚实体量逐渐碎裂为透明云雾般颜料，让构图具有明确扩张方向。焦点结构周围保留硬轮廓，外缘则蒸发进浅色底面。柔和侧光挑出部分隆起，宽阔暗块下留深影。大片留白平衡有纹理的羽状色云和细竖痕。成品有大气感、触感与安静的躁动。
theme_en: An older man in a dark hat dissolving into smoky blue paint
theme_zh: 戴深色帽子、消融于蓝色烟雾笔触中的年长男子
name: David Lean
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
